payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brittny, Cordia, Deja, Kaci

payload.content:
Hi all — Cordia here. My skills are mobile-development (0.68), availability 5.0h. My costs are lowest on the ISSUE-0001 (mobile-development) tasks: triage=2.72, review=3.40, docs=3.40, test=4.76, implement=6.80. ISSUE-0002 costs are very high for me (20-40), so I'd prefer to stay on ISSUE-0001.

My proposal: I'll take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 3.40). If someone else strongly wants review, I can flex to docs or triage instead. Please state your preferred ISSUE-0001 task so we avoid duplicates. Brittny, Deja, Kaci — what are your skill matches and preferred tasks?

Follow-up: to maximize joint score we should all take distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks (there are 5, so 4 agents can all get one). Proposed split (adjust freely): Cordia=triage, and please let me know if you'd rather have triage — I can swap to review/docs. Let's each announce a distinct task. Please confirm your pick so we don't collide on the same micro-task.

Kaci here. Skills: mobile-development 0.98, devops 0.98; availability 7.0h. My costs favor ISSUE-0001 (high priority): triage=2.03, review=2.54, docs=2.54, test=3.56, implement=5.08. ISSUE-0002 is worse for me (review=3.39, test=4.75, implement=6.79).

Proposal to avoid collisions: I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage (my cheapest, cost 2.03). Cordia — you mentioned possibly taking triage, so if you strongly prefer it I can flex to review (2.54) or docs (2.54). Otherwise please take review/docs. Brittny, Deja — please announce distinct ISSUE-0001 picks so all 4 of us land on distinct high-priority tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brittny here. Skills: data-science 0.91, availability 7.0h. My costs (all on ISSUE-0001, high priority): triage=2.16, review=2.70, docs=2.70, test=3.78, implement=5.41. ISSUE-0002 is terrible for me (review=20, test=28, implement=40), so I'll stay on ISSUE-0001.

Proposed distinct split for the 4 of us over the 5 high-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks:
- Kaci = ISSUE-0001::triage (2.03)
- Cordia = ISSUE-0001::review (3.40)
- Brittny (me) = ISSUE-0001::docs (2.70)
- Deja = ISSUE-0001::test or implement

I'm happy to take docs. If Cordia would rather have docs, I can flex to review. Deja — please announce your pick (test/implement) so we land on 4 distinct high-priority tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quick clarification on my proposal: I'll commit to ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70). That keeps us all distinct: Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test (or implement). If anyone needs docs, say so and I can swap to review. Deja, please confirm you can take test or implement so we cover 4 distinct high-priority tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Cordia confirming: I'll take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 3.40). Agreed split — Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test (or implement). All 4 distinct, all HIGH priority ISSUE-0001.

Kaci/Brittny: I'm locking review, so please hold triage/docs respectively to keep us distinct. Deja: please confirm test or implement (whichever isn't collided) so we cover 4 distinct high-priority tasks.

Note for Deja: my ISSUE-0002 costs are 20-40, so I can't usefully cover 0002 — the 0001 tasks are the shared win. Committing to ISSUE-0001::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Kaci confirming: I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.03, my cheapest). Locked split — Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test (or implement). All 4 distinct, all HIGH priority on ISSUE-0001. Deja, please confirm test/implement so we cover 4 distinct high-priority tasks. I'll commit ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brittny confirming final split: Kaci=ISSUE-0001::triage (2.03), Cordia=ISSUE-0001::review (3.40), Brittny=ISSUE-0001::docs (2.70), Deja=ISSUE-0001::test or implement. All 4 distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks — this maximizes tasks_done and priority_sum for our group.

I am locking ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70) and will commit it in execution. Deja — please take test (effort 2.1) or implement (effort 3.0), whichever you prefer, but avoid docs/review/triage since those are locked. No swaps needed from my side. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Cordia final: locking ISSUE-0001::review (cost 3.40). Deja — you're the only one who hasn't announced. Please take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.1) or ISSUE-0001::implement (effort 3.0), whichever is cheaper for you; avoid triage/review/docs (locked by Kaci/Cordia/Brittny). That gives 4 distinct HIGH-priority tasks. Committing ISSUE-0001::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Kaci final confirmation: locking ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.03, my cheapest, high priority, strong mobile-development match). Split stands — Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test/implement. All 4 distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks. I will commit ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Deja, please confirm your distinct pick (test or implement).

Brittny final lock: ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70, high priority, data-science match). Split stands: Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test/implement — 4 distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks. I will commit ISSUE-0001::docs in execution. Deja, please confirm your distinct pick.

Cordia final (planning done): locking ISSUE-0001::review (cost 3.40, high priority, mobile-development match). Split stands — Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test/implement. All 4 distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks. I will commit ISSUE-0001::review in execution. Deja, please confirm test or implement.

Kaci confirming once more and locking: ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.03, my cheapest; high priority; strong mobile-development match). Final split: Kaci=triage, Cordia=review, Brittny=docs, Deja=test or implement. All 4 distinct HIGH-priority ISSUE-0001 tasks. I will commit ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Deja, please take test or implement (avoid triage/review/docs). No further changes from me.

Deja here. Thanks for the coordination — but I can't profitably take ISSUE-0001::test/implement. My skills are devops:0.70 (no mobile-development/data-science match), so my ISSUE-0001 costs are very high: triage=12.00, review=15.00, docs=15.00, test=21.00, implement=30.00. Meanwhile ISSUE-0002 (devops tag) is cheap for me: review=4.47, test=6.26, implement=8.94.

So I'll take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.47, low priority). Reasoning: tasks_done is the same either way (4 total), but taking 0001::test would add ~16.5 extra cost for only +0.5 priority weight — a bad trade unless priority_bonus is huge. Since none of you can cheaply cover 0002, I'm the efficient one to do it.

Final split: Kaci=ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia=ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny=ISSUE-0001::docs, Deja=ISSUE-0002::review. All distinct, no collisions. Please don't take ISSUE-0002::review. I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Brittny: Acknowledged, Deja — your reasoning is sound. Final split locked: Kaci=ISSUE-0001::triage, Cordia=ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny=ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70), Deja=ISSUE-0002::review. All distinct, no collisions, 4 tasks done (3 high + 1 low priority). No one will touch ISSUE-0002::review. I will commit ISSUE-0001::docs in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)
